policy.selection_unit: Whole six-channel vector; same frozen warning for all seeds
policy.scope: All 408 subject107 segment/regime cases for 3 residual seeds; overall and by loss age
policy.assumption: MLP, LOCF and warning states depend only on received observations; emitted reconstructions never feed back. Source errors can therefore be recombined on disjoint groups.
policy.formula: sum_abs/sum_sq = MLP.unwarned + LOCF.warned + LOCF.unknown; add counts before MAE and sqrt(mean squared error)
policy.primary_usefulness_pass: Strictly lower full-coverage equal-regime/channel training-std-normalized MAE than unchanged MLP for EACH of 3 residual seeds
policy.secondary: All channel/regime and loss-age MAE/RMSE changes, including regressions; compare full LOCF too
policy.no_tuning: No changed warning thresholds, channel-specific routing, seed selection, training or new masks
policy.limits: Exploratory saved-validation-sum analysis, not a new streaming hybrid implementation or hardware result; no cross-subject claim
policy.startup: Unknown uses original LOCF availability; current protected-warmup benchmark has no unknown hidden positions
